tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: To qualify for award of this contract each tenderer in its name should have Satisfactory completed as prime Supplier/tenderer, at least one similar goods and services (in one Supply Order) such as Providing Catering Services and / or running hotel/canteen/ Restaurant of value not less than Rs 151.62 Lakhs in last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26 (performance certificate must be certifying by the competent authority not less than the Ranking of EE)

The tenderer/firms/individuals should have Registered with the Concerned Statutory Authorities (Tenderer needs to submit registration certificate from the competent authority i.e Registration Under Companies Act (Or) GST)
The tenderer/firms/individuals should have registered with Labour Department (Labour Licenses), (Total Number of Labour not lessthan 35 Members)
The tenderer/firms/individuals should have registered with Regional Provident Fund Commissioner for Provident Fund (EPF) Registration certificate and latest 3 months challans to be enclosed.
The tenderer/firms/individuals should have registered with Employees State Insurance Corporation (ESI)
Copies of license issued by the department of health and family welfare/competent authority under FSSAI Act 2006 to ensure quality of food supplied for Catering Service/Hotel Business

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certificate under Food Safety Act

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Valid GST Certificate with GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C statement for last three years to be enclosed

To qualify for award of this contract each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26 achieved in at least two financial years a minimum financial turnover Rs 606.48 Lakhs. (Certified with UDIN number)
